description: Complex of ditches and pits dated from the mid 1st CE, in the later 4th CE structures were built, including a four-post timber structure surrounded by circular gullies. This structure is suggested to be a possible shrine.
bibliography: Leary. “Excavations at the Romano-British Settlement at Pasture Lodge Farm, Long Bennington, Lincolnshire, 1975-77 by H. M. Wheeler.” Occasional Papers in Lincolnshire History and Archaeology 10 (1994).
Martyn, Blick, Brindle, and et al. “Pasture Lodge Farm, Long Bennington (Lincolnshire).” The Rural Settlement of Roman Britain: an online resource, 2015. https://doi.org/10.5284/1030449.
